exclude.reason: Annulled by FIFA after a refereeing error (penalty retake); replayed 8 Oct 2005 (1-1), second leg 12 Oct 2005 (0-0). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2006_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_%E2%80%93_AFC_fourth_round

accept.reason: The datasets differ on the date (9 vs 13 Sep); the result 2-1 agrees. RSSSF: 09.09.92, Aleppo, 1992 Arab Cup group stage, noted as not rated internationally because Palestine had not joined FIFA. https://rsssf.org/tablesa/arabcup92-details.html
